name: syrk
signature: void syrk(long n, long m, double alpha, double beta, double *C, const double *A)
layout: C is an n x n matrix and A is an n x m matrix, both stored row-major: element (i, j) of a matrix with c columns is at index i*c + j. C is input and output. Only the lower triangle of C, including the diagonal (j <= i), is updated; the entries above the diagonal must be left unchanged. C and A do not overlap. n and m are at least 1.
